data.narrative:
SatSure is a Series B-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Prateep Basu. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Skyryse), supplemented by observation of 5 public Space & Aerospace traded comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

The Peer-Median method is the applicable triangulation approach. Across the 4 private comparables, valuations range from $1.1B (Skyryse, Series C) to $8.0B (Sierra Space, Series C), with a median of $1.6B. This median serves as the primary valuation anchor. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples is not applicable; while the Space & Aerospace sector shows a median price-to-sales of 24.4x across 6 public tickers, SatSure's revenue is not disclosed, precluding multiple application.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.4B (low) to $1.9B (high), centered at $1.6B median. This reflects reliance on a single method with limited peer granularity. Key uncertainties include stage positioning within Series B (early vs. late) relative to comparables and the wide spread in the peer set ($1.1B–$8.0B), driven partly by stage variation among comparables. Revenue traction and growth trajectory would strengthen conviction in placement within the derived range.
